## Findings

**1. `DetachedTarget` / render-into-target signatures**

```
framework/gpu/3d.zig:14919  pub const DetachedTarget = struct { slot: Rt = .{}, pub fn deinit(self: *DetachedTarget) void {...} };
framework/gpu/3d.zig:14935  pub fn renderDetached(io: std.Io, environ: *const std.process.Environ.Map, target: *DetachedTarget, node: *Node, w: f32, h: f32) ?*wgpu.TextureView
framework/gpu/3d.zig:15383  fn drawScene(io: std.Io, environ: *const std.process.Environ.Map, scene_node: *Node, slot: *Rt, vp_x: f32, vp_y: f32, w: f32, h: f32) void   // private; renderDetached is the public entry
```
`DetachedTarget` has no `acquire`/`release` fns — just the `slot: Rt` field and `deinit`. `renderDetached` calls `ensureRt(&target.slot, iw, ih)` (3d.zig:14940) then `drawScene(...)` (3d.zig:14942), which owns its own encoder/submit — nothing touches the swapchain.

`world_window.zig` acquires and calls it via a thin wrapper:
```
framework/gpu/world_window.zig:73   var g_target: scene3d.DetachedTarget = .{};
framework/world_loader.zig:240      pub fn renderDetachedView(io, environ, node_id: u32, target: *scene3d.DetachedTarget, w: f32, h: f32) ?*wgpu.TextureView
framework/world_loader.zig:246          return scene3d.renderDetached(io, environ, target, &runtime.root, w, h);
framework/gpu/world_window.zig:319  const view = world_loader.renderDetachedView(io, environ, WINDOW_NODE_ID, &g_target, @floatFromInt(g_width), @floatFromInt(g_height)) orelse return;
```

**2. Camera source — no explicit pose parameter; reads a global**

`drawScene` (3d.zig:15426-15447) walks `scene_node.children` looking for `child.scene3d_camera`. If `child.scene3d_camera_orbit` is set it uses the **global module-level orbit state**: `cam_pos = orbitCamPos()` / `cam_look = g_orbit.target` (3d.zig:15433-15439, `g_orbit` declared 3d.zig:453). Otherwise it reads explicit per-node fields `child.scene3d_pos_x/y/z`, `scene3d_look_x/y/z`, `scene3d_fov`, `scene3d_far`, `scene3d_near` (3d.zig:15441-15446) — so a caller CAN get an explicit pose only by building a scene tree whose `<Scene3D.Camera>` child is non-orbit and carries those explicit fields; there is no view/projection matrix parameter on `renderDetached`/`drawScene`.

The model-stage scene is `cart/editor/stage/ModelView.tsx`, which hardcodes `<Scene3D.Camera orbit>` (comment at ModelView.tsx:9, "the camera is the host's orbit camera"). That means the model stage always renders through the **same single global `g_orbit`** used by the live viewport — there is no per-scene camera state. To shoot an explicit pose you must mutate `g_orbit` via `__model_cam_set_pose` before calling `renderDetached`, and restore it after — an offscreen shot from this scene cannot be pose-isolated from the live editor's orbit without save/restore.

**3. capture.zig — the shared write path and swapchain readback**

```
framework/gpu/capture.zig:220  fn writeRegionPng(io: std.Io, path: []const u8, pixels: [*]const u8, stride: u32, cx: u32, cy: u32, cw: u32, ch: u32) void   // "one write path" (comment at 218-219), BGRA→RGBA swizzle then writePng
framework/gpu/capture.zig:43   fn writePng(io: std.Io, path: []const u8, rgba: []const u8, w: u32, h: u32) bool                                        // stbi_write_png_to_func + std.Io file write
framework/gpu/capture.zig:248  pub fn writeRgbaPng(io: std.Io, path: []const u8, rgba: []const u8, w: u32, h: u32) bool                                 // already-RGBA path (used by model-package writer)
framework/gpu/gpu.zig:490      pub const CaptureCallback = *const fn (io: std.Io, pixels: [*]const u8, w: u32, h: u32, stride: u32) void
framework/gpu/gpu.zig:496      pub fn captureScreenshot(cb: CaptureCallback) void
framework/gpu/gpu.zig:519      fn performCapture(io: std.Io, device: *wgpu.Device, q: *wgpu.Queue, texture: *wgpu.Texture) void
```
`performCapture` is invoked only at `gpu.zig:2622`: `const cap_t = if (g_kms) g_offscreen else capture_tex; if (cap_t) |t| performCapture(io, device, queue, t);` — always the main swapchain/offscreen surface texture, never caller-supplied. Callback delivers **BGRA8**, `stride` = 256-aligned `bytes_per_row` (padding possible; `writeRegionPng` strips it and swaps to RGBA).

An arbitrary-texture readback DOES exist, separate from the swapchain path: `pub fn readbackTexture(tex: *wgpu.Texture, w: u32, h: u32, swap_rb: bool) ?[]u8` at `framework/gpu/gpu.zig:1236` (uses `copyTextureToBuffer` at gpu.zig:1257). It returns a page-allocator buffer `[w:u32 LE][h:u32 LE][tight RGBA rows]` (gpu.zig:1233,1286-1316), with `swap_rb` doing BGRA→RGBA swizzle when the source format is BGRA. Existing callers: `gpu.zig:1229` (static-surface capture) and `framework/gpu/effects.zig:1466`. This is the function to point at a `DetachedTarget.slot.color_texture` for the offscreen model shot.

**4. `__capture_frame` registration**

```
framework/v8_bindings_capture.zig:51   fn captureFrame(info_c: ?*const v8.c.FunctionCallbackInfo) callconv(.c) void
framework/v8_bindings_capture.zig:115  v8_runtime.registerHostFn("__capture_frame", captureFrame);
```
`captureFrame` reads the `path` arg and calls `capture.requestFrame(path)` (capture.zig:270), which arms `gpu.captureScreenshot(&onLiveFramePixels)` — a one-shot queue of the swapchain readback on the NEXT rendered frame (disarms itself in `onLiveFramePixels`, capture.zig:282-290). It is gated behind the `has-capture` ingredient flag (file header, v8_bindings_capture.zig:12-14) and refuses if the F9 recorder owns the hook (capture.zig:271-274). This is swapchain-only — irrelevant to a DetachedTarget shot.

**5. `ZIGOS_HEADLESS`**

Read in 4 places:
```
framework/engine.zig:4095   const headless_skip_geo = environ.get("ZIGOS_HEADLESS") != null;   // skip window-geometry restore/persist
framework/engine.zig:4134   const headless = environ.get("ZIGOS_HEADLESS") != null;             // ORs into window_flags: SDL_WINDOW_HIDDEN (line 4138)
framework/world_loader.zig:343  const headless = init.environ_map.get("ZIGOS_HEADLESS") != null;
framework/render/render_surfaces.zig:1405  if (environ.get("ZIGOS_HEADLESS")) |v| { if (v.len > 0 and v[0] != '0') return null; }  // skip spawning subprocess feeds (qemu/Xvfb/kitty)
```
It only hides the SDL window (`SDL_WINDOW_HIDDEN`) and skips geometry persistence + heavy feed-subprocess spawning; the window still exists and still runs the full swapchain pipeline (this is exactly the mechanism `capture.zig`'s doc header says the env-mode screenshot flow relies on: `ZIGOS_HEADLESS=1 ZIGOS_SCREENSHOT=1`, world_loader.zig:22).

**6. Model-stage camera host fns** (all in `framework/v8_bindings_core.zig`, registered at lines 4722-4728)

```
v8_bindings_core.zig:640  fn hostModelOrbitDrag  — __model_orbit_drag(dx, dy)         → scene3d.orbitDrag(dx,dy)
v8_bindings_core.zig:649  fn hostModelOrbitZoom  — __model_orbit_zoom(delta)          → scene3d.orbitZoom(delta)
v8_bindings_core.zig:659  fn hostModelOrbitPan   — __model_orbit_pan(dx, dy)           → scene3d.orbitPan(dx,dy)
v8_bindings_core.zig:671  fn hostModelOrbitLock  — __model_orbit_lock(on)              → scene3d.orbitSetLocked(on)
v8_bindings_core.zig:680  fn hostModelCamPose    — __model_cam_pose() → "[yaw,pitch,dist,tx,ty,tz]"  (scene3d.orbitPose(), 3d.zig:466-467)
v8_bindings_core.zig:690  fn hostModelCamSetPose — __model_cam_set_pose(yaw, pitch, dist, tx, ty, tz) → 1|0   (scene3d.orbitSetPose, 3d.zig:469-479)
v8_bindings_core.zig:705  fn hostModelOrbitFrame — __model_orbit_frame(selection) → 1|0  (scene3d.orbitFrameCurrent, doc at 3d.zig:703)
```
`orbitSetPose`/`orbitFrameCurrent` all gate on `g_orbit.locked` (3d.zig:474,500,557) and mutate the same single global `g_orbit` consumed by `drawScene` — confirming Q2: there is no scene-scoped or caller-scoped camera, only this shared global, mutated through these doors.</result>
